notes: GAAP audit, FYE 9/30/2023. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); business-type from the proprietary funds statement Total column (p7). Business-type receipts total = operating revenues + interest income (no single printed total); business-type disbursements = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 3,131,731 (p2) = operating 3,080,416 + interest 46,003 + loan fees 5,312. Utility 'Other revenue' is in charges for services because the Statement of Activities charges for services (3,068,345) equal total operating revenues. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents' 2,697,774 (p4); county treasurer cash 47,304 printed separately. Detail: General Fund recorded from the departmental combining statement (pp15-16, department columns) rather than the GF budgetary comparison (p10, budget basis, totals 2,920,358 / 2,721,928) to avoid double counting; GF budget figures therefore not captured. Street, Special Assessments and EMS from their budget schedules (pp11-13; zero-actual budget lines omitted). Nonmajor funds per fund from p14 (Historic Lighting fund had no activity). No business-type detail (no separate proprietary schedule; statement-column lines removed 2026-11-12 to match FY2024, user rule 2026-10-28). Proprietary cash flows Total column on p9 (continuation of p8). Component units (Airport Authority, CRA) excluded. Read pages 1-16 of 16
